headline: Drury's defeat leaves Maryville alone at the top
dek: Drury's first conference defeat, at Missouri S&T on Wednesday, came on the afternoon Maryville won at Indianapolis, and the pair who were level at the weekend are level no longer. Maryville's season now reads eight wins, one draw and two defeats, thirty goals scored and twelve conceded.
displaced_by: Drury lost at Missouri S&T while Maryville won at Indianapolis; Maryville now lead alone

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's thirty-one goals are more than Lewis, Upper Iowa and William Jewell have scored between them, and they have conceded twenty-two doing it; the goals have not bought a place near the top of the table.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln remain the only programme in the conference yet to lose: five wins and three draws, sixteen goals scored and six conceded, the latest win coming at home to William Jewell on Wednesday.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Missouri S&T have still not drawn a match this season: seven wins and three defeats, twenty-one goals scored and eleven conceded, the seventh win coming at home to Drury on Wednesday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result, and both are Drury's, one at home and one away, both from August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Truman have scored eighteen goals and conceded twenty, and Jacob Panagos has ten of the eighteen from twenty-five shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Smith has made thirty-seven saves for William Jewell and conceded six, a save percentage of .860.

last_match.line: Maryville have won every conference match since their draw at Truman; Indianapolis had not lost at home in conference play until this.

next_match.line: Illinois Springfield's only conference win came away, at Missouri-St. Louis; William Jewell's came at home, against Truman.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
